therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Structured risk communication protocol incorporating clinical history, neuroimaging, genetics, and biomarkers
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Cognitive processing and emotional adaptation to dementia risk information
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Individuals with mild cognitive impairment and healthy aging adults with their co-participants

results.effect_size: Comprehension scores ranged 63-100% across groups and timepoints
results.target_engagement_evidence: Demonstrated comprehension and recall of risk information across multiple domains
subgroup_findings: Amyloid positive participants showed lower comprehension scores than amyloid negative participants
Co-participants of amyloid positive participants showed higher distress scores

context.indication: Mild cognitive impairment and healthy aging
